verdict.rationale: Cekura's observability ingestion accepts a call's transcript, recording URL, and metadata as a CallLog. Its PII redaction works on audio recordings, so audio is captured and processed alongside call data. Support is limited to voice-call audio linked by URL at the call level; nothing shows arbitrary multimodal payloads attached to trace spans. Missing for 10: image payload capture, file/attachment capture, span-level multimodal attachment in traces (e.g. LiveKit tracing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
